t: Swarfega Hand Cleanser provides a powerful solution for removing ingrained oil, grease, and dirt from hands. This heavy-duty hand cleaner is an essential item for mechanics, builders, and trade professionals who regularly encounter tough grime. It features non-abrasive cornmeal scrubbing agents for effective cleaning without harshness. The formula includes a skin moisturiser to prevent dryness and leaves hands with a pleasant orange fragrance. Being solvent-free and silicone-free, it is dermatologically tested and shown to be non-irritating, ensuring hands are clean and cared for after a hard day's work.
b: Fast, Efficient Cleaning of Heavy Duty Dirt & Grime
